test_case.test_name: AMD OOB GFX block2 to GC fatal CPER validation
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved GFX uncorrectable stimulus creates a unique CPER decoded as the intended OAM GC bank with ext59 fatal type.
required_package: AMD-approved GFX command to GC CPER-bank relationship
Secure Systems/UBB endpoint, CA/auth and CPER schema
Dedicated idle GPU SUT and GPU/BMC/host OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures complete CPER/health baseline, validates device/block/GC mapping and secure endpoint, runs `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -s 0 -t 4` once, identifies the unique new entry, hash-verifies and decodes its attachment, checks OAM/GC/ext59/GFX_IP_Fatal_Error/fatal fields, then verifies recovery.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one attributable CPER identifies the intended OAM and GC bank with ext59 GFX_IP_Fatal_Error and fatal severity; GPU/BMC/host recover healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved GFX-to-GC mapping, one injection, unique artifact, exact decoder fields and recovery. SDMA/MMHUB bank, ambiguous record, wrong severity, missing attachment or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical error authorization on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not infer GFX-to-GC mapping or use malformed/insecure endpoint.
Preserve full baseline and use entry diff rather than index alone.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Complete CPER baseline and injection transcript
Unique new entry and attachment hashes
test_case.recovery: On wrong GPU, fatal hang or lost connectivity, preserve BMC evidence and use only approved OOB recovery; never inject/reset automatically and verify all accelerators afterward.
